headline: Clinton order added members to the President's Council on Sustainable Development and extended how long the council would exist.
what_it_does: This executive order changed an existing White House advisory group called the President's Council on Sustainable Development. Based on its title, it allowed more members to join the council and extended the council's term so it could keep working past its earlier end date. No summary was provided, so details such as the number of new members or the new end date are not available here.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the President's Council on Sustainable Development
who_it_affects.how: The council gained additional members and was allowed to keep operating for a longer period.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed June 30, 1997; exact effective date and new end date not stated in the available material.
